1. `fs.go` `moveFile`: tries `rename` (a package var so tests can simulate EXDEV); if src is a dir and dst an existing real dir → `mergeDir` (moves entries one by one recursively, then removes src); on EXDEV → `moveAcrossDevices`: copy (symlink/dir/file), `syncFS` (unix.Syncfs on dst's dir) and only then `os.RemoveAll(src)`; on copy failure removes dst only if it did not exist before.
